name: ai-call-engine
description: Standalone AI Phone Calling Engine — automatic outbound AI calls on request closure

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test:unit: cd packages/backend && npx vitest run tests/unit
scripts.test:integration: cd packages/backend && npx vitest run tests/integration
scripts.lint: npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/backend/tsconfig.json
